fingerprint.structure: 1 slide: a centre title block ringed by 8 labelled items on white (3 top, 1 left, 1 right, 3 bottom). Each item is a cut-out, an app icon or a short text stack, with a 1 to 2 line label under it
fingerprint.hook: identity starter pack: 'peak <identity> purchases' as a 3-line centre title + a small grey '<tribe> edition' subline. The items are the purchases that make you that identity, from serious (laptop, desk) to joke (domain names you collect, an AI subscription)
fingerprint.camera_motion: other:essentials-flatlay. Designed card: product cut-outs, app icons and one text item on white, labels drawn in a bold grotesk. Static image
fingerprint.pacing: single image, about 25 words: a 3-line title, a subline and 8 short labels
fingerprint.text_overlay: title: heavy grotesk (SF Pro Display Heavy look), lowercase, black, 3 stacked lines, centred, about 6% of frame height per line, tight leading. Subline: semibold grey #555, about 2.3%. Labels: semibold black Title Case, about 2.2%, centred under each item
fingerprint.audio: original sound by another account (Elite Motivation), music bed, no voiceover
fingerprint.arc: recognition and aspiration: the viewer checks off what they've bought; the domain names and the AI subscription are the in-jokes
